name: DigiRig Mobile
notes: CM108 codec; the CP2102 CAT/PTT port is a sibling USB device. Source: digirig.net product page and Digirig support forum lsusb reports (0d8c:013c, C-Media Electronics)

name: DigiRig Lite
notes: tone keyed on the right channel; CM108B codec, same C-Media vendor id as the Mobile. Source: digirig.net Digirig Lite page

name: AIOC
notes: all-in-one cable, HID PTT. Source: pid.codes registry https://pid.codes/1209/7388/ (skuep/AIOC project)

name: SignaLink USB
notes: TI PCM2906C codec. Source: SignaLink USB support docs and reported lsusb output identifying the device as a Texas Instruments PCM2906C

name: Icom USB codec
notes: IC-7300 default model and baud; unverified - published lsusb output for 0c26:0036 (Raspberry Pi forum thread, DeviceHunt vendor 0C26 listing) identifies this id as an IC-705, not the IC-7300; no IC-7300-specific lsusb capture was found to confirm or replace it

name: CP2102 serial
notes: serial-only candidate (CAT cable or DigiRig port); Silicon Labs factory-default CP210x id. Source: linux kernel cp210x driver USB_DEVICE table and usb-ids.gowdy.us/read/UD/10c4/ea60

name: FTDI serial
notes: serial-only candidate; FTDI factory-default FT232R id. Source: FTDI Technical Note TN_100 (USB VID/PID Guidelines)
